caption_L1: Poland : Budget balance between 2015 to 2025 in relation to GDP is a bar chart. The y-axis plots Year along categorical scale from 2015 to 2025* while the x-axis plots Budget balance in relation to GDP as categorical scale starting with −0.10 and ending with 0.00.
caption_L2L3: Between 2015 and 2020 the budget balance was low - dropping at times to -0.020 and mostly reduced year on year. In 2020 there was a big change with budget balance increasing to over -0.10, this appears to be an outlier on the chart, with subsequent years dropping again to around -0.04 and remaining fairly stable until 2025.
